articles.title: AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents
articles.summary: AssetForge is a task-construction pipeline for training business automation agents by combining reusable application, state, policy, and assertion assets with task-specific rubrics. In benchmark testing, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples improved AutomationBench strict pass@1 performance to 41.17%, versus a 9.33% base score and 30.33% for traditional rubrics at the same example scale.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early research signal that agentic business automation may improve through better training data pipelines, reusable workflow assets, and executable verification. While not a commercial deployment, it points to the broader enterprise AI need for reliable task validation, workflow-specific training, and scalable agent development infrastructure.

articles.title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
articles.summary: The paper introduces OmniSimulator, a training framework for small language models aimed at improving realistic user-behavior simulation in short-video platform environments. articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early technical development rather than a directly investable corporate announcement, but it points to continued progress in making smaller models more useful for production-like tasks.
